title: The Crusaders "DOUBLE CROSS" 1981 PRINT Chick Publications Comic Vol. 13
descriptionText:
This vintage comic book, "The Crusaders: Double-Cross" from 1981, is a must-have for collectors of US comics. Published by Chick Pub, this single issue comic book is part of the The Crusaders series, written by Jack T. Chick and featuring the character Alberto. 

With its action-packed and religious genre, this comic book provides a thrilling read. The comic book is in English and has a publication year of 1981, making it a great addition to any comic book collection. This issue number 13, features the story title "Double-Cross" and is a great example of the Bronze Age (1970-83) era of comics.
